title: AI Engineer Interview Preparation
description: The 2026 AI Engineer interview loop: LLM fundamentals, RAG, agents, evals, LLMOps, fine-tuning and system design, with a 267-question bank, 10 worked system designs and 12 company loops. Imported from awesome-ai-engineer-interview (MIT).

modules.title: LLM Fundamentals
modules.description: Prefill/decode, tokens, context windows, sampling, reasoning models, KV cache, attention and transformer internals.

modules.title: RAG
modules.description: Embeddings and ANN, recall@k/precision@k, chunking, hybrid search with RRF, reranking, scale math, evaluation and ACLs.

modules.title: Agents & MCP
modules.description: Agent vs workflow, ReAct, tool and ACI design, error compounding, MCP, memory and state.

modules.title: Evaluation & Reliability
modules.description: Rings of testing, LLM-as-judge calibration, pass@k vs pass^k, trajectory vs outcome evaluation, error analysis.

modules.title: LLMOps, Cost & Latency
modules.description: Prompt and semantic caching, tiered routing, reliable clients, hedging, fallbacks and silent regressions.

modules.title: Fine-tuning & Inference
modules.description: RAG vs fine-tuning vs prompting, LoRA/QLoRA, RLHF/DPO/GRPO, quantization, PagedAttention, speculative decoding.

modules.title: ML / LLM System Design
modules.description: The reusable design rubric, whiteboard estimation, latency budgets and tradeoff reasoning.

modules.title: Prompting & Structured Output
modules.description: Static contract vs context, chain-of-thought and self-consistency, constrained decoding, schemas.

modules.title: Security & Guardrails
modules.description: Prompt injection, the lethal trifecta, EchoLeak, CaMeL/dual-LLM, OWASP LLM Top 10.

modules.title: Interview Question Bank
modules.description: 267 questions by topic: 196 multiple-choice checkpoints with per-option explanations and 71 reported questions with sources.

modules.title: Worked System Designs
modules.description: One reusable rubric applied to 10 numeric, worked AI system designs.

modules.title: Company Interview Guides
modules.description: Per-company loops for 12 AI companies with sourced questions and signature rounds.

modules.title: Study Plans & Resources
modules.description: The repository guide with 1-week and 1-month study plans, the resource hub, the quality spec, and source attribution.
